title: Lab retest of the marble finds no iridium

tellings.quote: So I can already tell like this is going to be nowhere near dense enough for a heavy metal like uh aridium.

related.note: This is the same marble and the same question of what it is made of as telling 4, but Zodakis's lab retest finds no iridium, so the two claims contradict each other.

plain: A small marble from a site said to be a UFO crash, which an earlier scan had read as about 40 percent iridium, a very heavy rare metal, did not hold up when retested. Matthew Zodakis says he ran the test himself in his own lab and found the piece "nowhere near dense enough for a heavy metal like iridium." His result cuts against the earlier claim that the marble was an unusual metal object.
